mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.work_id, w.title, i.resource_url AS cover_url, h.watch_status, h.watched_episodes, a.episode_count, TO_CHAR(h.recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS recorded_at FROM fl_watch_history h JOIN fl_anime a ON a.work_id = h.work_id JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = h.work_id LEFT JOIN fl_work_image i ON i.work_id = h.work_id AND i.image_kind = 'COVER' AND i.sort_order = 0 WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.recorded_at DESC, h.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: FROM fl_inbox_notice n JOIN fl_forum_post p ON p.id = n.post_id AND p.state = 'VISIBLE' LEFT JOIN fl_forum_comment c ON c.id = n.comment_id AND c.state = 'VISIBLE' WHERE n.recipient_id = #{userId} AND (p.screening_thread = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fl_work w WHERE w.id = p.work_id AND w.is_listed = 1)) AND (p.screening_thread = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fl_community_setting WHERE id = 1 AND is_open = 1)) AND ( (n.kind = 'POST_LIKE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fl_forum_like l WHERE l.post_id = n.post_id AND l.user_id = n.actor_id )) OR (c.id IS NOT NULL AND (n.kind = 'POST_COMMENT' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fl_forum_comment parent WHERE parent.id = c.parent_id AND parent.state = 'VISIBLE' ))) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AND n.read_at IS NULL

SELECT feed.id, feed.kind, a.display_name AS actor_name, a.avatar_key, feed.post_id, feed.title AS post_title, feed.screening_work_id, SUBSTR(feed.body, 1, 180) AS excerpt, TO_CHAR(feed.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, CASE WHEN feed.read_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "READ" FROM fl_account a JOIN ( SELECT n.id, n.actor_id, n.kind, n.post_id, p.title, CASE WHEN p.screening_thread = 1 THEN p.work_id END AS screening_work_id, c.body, n.created_at, n.read_at
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY ) feed ON feed.actor_id = a.id ORDER BY feed.created_at DESC, feed.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fl_inbox_notice (recipient_id, actor_id, post_id, comment_id, kind, created_at) SELECT p.author_id, c.author_id, p.id, c.id, 'POST_COMMENT', c.created_at FROM fl_forum_comment c JOIN fl_forum_post p ON p.id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN fl_forum_comment parent ON parent.id = c.parent_id AND parent.state = 'VISIBLE' WHERE c.id = #{commentId} AND p.screening_thread = 0 AND p.author_id <> c.author_id AND (parent.author_id IS NULL OR parent.author_id <> p.author_id) UNION ALL SELECT parent.author_id, c.author_id, c.post_id, c.id, 'COMMENT_REPLY', c.created_at FROM fl_forum_comment c JOIN fl_forum_comment parent ON parent.id = c.parent_id AND parent.state = 'VISIBLE' WHERE c.id = #{commentId} AND parent.author_id <> c.author_id
mapper.update: MERGE INTO fl_inbox_notice n USING (SELECT id AS post_id, author_id FROM fl_forum_post WHERE id = #{postId} AND author_id <> #{actorId}) p ON (n.recipient_id = p.author_id AND n.actor_id = #{actorId} AND n.post_id = p.post_id AND n.kind = 'POST_LIKE') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (recipient_id, actor_id, post_id, kind) VALUES (p.author_id, #{actorId}, p.post_id, 'POST_LIKE')
